releaseNotes: Google Cloud Firestore Database: Permanent persistence for player profiles, friend codes (HLH-XXXXX), and real-time presence across Cloud Run sleep/wake cycles.
Guest Account Auto-Registration: Guest profiles are now immediately indexed in the global player directory so anyone can add and play with friends right away.
Gameplay Commentary Collision Fix: Commentary and status messages are now docked to the Center Trick Arena, completely resolving overlap with North opponent nameplates in Bondi and Dhihaeh.
Dhihaeh Trump Cut Fanfare: Live 2.5s announcement modal with large glowing suit emblems and Dhivehi calligraphy (ހުކުމް ކަނޑައެޅުން) the moment a trump is declared.
Swipeable Lobby Game Carousel: Added smooth horizontal touch swipe and mouse drag support with haptics to effortlessly toggle between Digu, Dhihaeh, and Bondi.
